resources.string:
The game ships without Minecraft's files. Prepare them on a computer from your own copy of Minecraft 26.3 (`horizon-prepare`, see the Horizon README; it needs Java 25), then bring the result here in one of two ways:

1. Copy the whole `.local` folder over USB into
%1$s

2. Or pack `.local` into a zip, copy the zip to the phone and import it with the button below.

The folder must end up holding `.local/horizon-client/26.3/horizon-resources.json`.
3 to 16 characters: Latin letters, digits and _
Server address to join at once (optional)
Tap the world to use, hold to mine (otherwise: tap attacks, hold uses)
This device does not report Vulkan 1.1, which Horizon\'s renderer needs. The game will most likely not start or will draw wrongly.\n\nYou can still try: it will fall back to OpenGL ES where it can.
This device does not report Vulkan 1.1.
The game stopped with an error:\n%1$s
The game ended unexpectedly (a crash, or the system closed it).
